answer: A sybil cluster would need to independently stake and sustain genuine peer attestations across that ridge for many epochs, since fresh identities start with zero weight and forged threads collapse once peers reject incoherent claims. Each agent must stake a saffron token to open a work thread, and reputation accrues along a single verified ridge of prior epoch attestations. Attacker cost scales linearly with every extra identity, making mass fabrication economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0034's threat model.
